question: At what moment and by what analogy is liberation said to be assured?
premises: The time of the departure of the life-breath is specified.
An analogy is drawn with Vārāṇasī.
The result is asserted as certain.
inference: Liberation is assured at the moment of death, as in Vārāṇasī.
plain_english: Certainly, at the time of the departure of the life-breath, it is as in Vārāṇasī.
